existing_fixture_scope: Primary lookup all 65,536 two-byte values and independent widths/padding; one-bit literal lengths 0..63; every legal match length/distance at eight bit offsets, fixed/dynamic trees and both padding values; prefix/suffix and exact/short limits; PNG/APNG/Adam7 and metadata in the full release suite.
performance_scope: Direct prefetched literal runs avoid staging copies. Per-coded-block extraction keeps large Huffman frames out of stored-block decoding. Repeated photo decode +2.65% relative to Rust png (unchanged reader +0.89%); format raw inflate +9.43% relative to flate2 (unchanged streaming inflate -0.60%). End-to-end format results are inconclusive. Shared-host measurements do not establish broad parity.
stored_probe_scope: 4096 iterations per case per process. Gray8 stored-only raw inflate: -5.06% relative to flate2, -2.58% relative to unchanged streaming inflate; both stored cases improve end-to-end relative to both controls. Earlier -10.23% unchanged-control regression is not repeated. Stored-only speedup is not claimed.
